summary: Dorian LPG Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new seven-year $368.4 million credit facility to refinance existing indebtedness, along with a press release on forward chartering estimates and a VLGC newbuilding contract. The facility is led by Nordea and includes sustainability-linked features. This is a routine debt refinancing and operational update, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No board recommendations, strategic reviews, or deal terms triggering special-situation classification are present. The filing is a conventional financing arrangement and forward-looking operational disclosure, warranting no event-driven category.
